site.title: Frontend Labs — Engineering Field Guides
site.tagline: Long-form, hands-on guides from the kernel to the browser. Read them as books, follow the series, run the labs.

categories.title: The systems, networking & security series
categories.note: Seven guides designed as one course: OS → networking → security → the HTTPS walkthrough, with Go alongside every step.

categories.title: Languages
categories.note: The languages the labs and projects are written in.

categories.title: Foundations
categories.note: Algorithms and the mathematics underneath them.

guides.title: Operating Systems, Linux & Containers
guides.summary: Processes, memory, files, sockets, containers, Kubernetes — and Go on Linux, including a container runtime you build.

guides.title: The OSI Model, One Click at a Time
guides.summary: One “Place order” click through all seven layers: real addresses, a millisecond timeline, and a debugging playbook by layer.

guides.title: Networking from Zero (TCP/IP)
guides.summary: L1–L4 in depth with packet captures and professional network operations, plus 23 Go labs.

guides.title: Security from Zero
guides.summary: Encoding vs hashing vs encryption, TLS packet by packet, your own CA, SSH hardening, and the OWASP Top 10.

guides.title: Security Engineering in Depth
guides.summary: Cloud and Kubernetes security, distributed authorization, advanced web attacks, data protection, detection — 10 Go labs.

guides.title: The HTTPS Request Lifecycle
guides.summary: One request end to end, then the server side built in Go; the finale traces one request through every guide.

guides.title: Go — The Complete Field Guide
guides.summary: Syntax to systems internals, concurrency, networking, security services, and production operations.

guides.title: Go 120-Day Engineering Plan
guides.summary: Daily exercises that grow into an L4 load balancer, a TLS proxy, a WAF, DDoS defences, and an edge security proxy.

guides.title: C — The Complete Field Guide
guides.summary: Memory, pointers, the standard library, real allocators, SQLite/Redis/curl walkthroughs, and a Linux driver.

guides.title: JavaScript — The Complete Field Guide
guides.summary: The language from beginner to expert, how browser engines render a page, HTTP from the browser, and Web Workers.

guides.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
guides.summary: Plain-language explanations, real-world analogies, pseudocode, and Go implementations for every core topic.

guides.title: Real-Life Mathematics
guides.summary: Number systems, probability, linear algebra, calculus, crypto, and control theory, each tied to a real engineering decision.

guides.title: TCP/IP — The Complete Field Guide (reference)
guides.summary: The denser companion to Networking from Zero: a lookup manual for the TCP/IP suite, from packets to performance forensics.

guides.title: AI from Zero to LLMs
guides.summary: From classical ML through Transformers to training, serving, and optimizing LLMs, plus agents and governance.

guides.title: Scale, Load & Performance Testing
guides.summary: Network and latency fundamentals, percentiles and jitter, open-source load-test tools, and simulations.
